scope.method: Read retained evidence, current local source and official Blender5.2 primary source only.

primary_sources.observed_source_behavior: modal_operators skips all handlers whose type is not WM_HANDLER_TYPE_OP.
UI dispatch installs handler-local area/region/popup context then restores or clears it; key matching checks active flag, event type/value and other dispatch conditions.
Internal button states distinguish numeric/text editing and open menus; IME composition is read from window runtime ime_data and ime_data_is_composing.
Public handler enumeration includes load/render lifecycle callbacks, not a transparent general UI post-dispatch observer.
is_job_running(job_type) queries the specified WM job type, with a special shader compilation path.
Internal window-system capability flags distinguish window position and IME support; support is not per-window composition state.

observations: Timer/draw region_popup remained null with actual F3 popup and numeric editing.
Hovered property did not establish active editing ownership.
Actual translate modal operator was observed in five samples.
prior_native_evidence.limit: Disproves null-to-false use for these tested observers, not every possible native observer.

observed_local_source.interface: SessionRuntime.state_provider(observation,next_state_version) -> StateFact mapping; missing facts remain UNKNOWN and required uncertainty must be <=0.1.
native_partial: OS foreground window identity and geometry
RNA_partial: Selection and mode in a selected window/view layer
fixture_only: Cursor-hit editor selection and first viewport selection are not proven keyboard dispatch identity.

inferred_feasibility.smallest_reachable_path: Use the existing provider callback for fresh version-bound native and explicitly window/view-layer/region-bound RNA facts over an authenticated read-only transport. Leave unresolved UI authorization facts UNKNOWN.
inferred_feasibility.provenance: RNA bridge is APP_TELEMETRY/API-assisted; read-only does not mean PIXELS_ONLY.
inferred_feasibility.missing_deployed_capability: No supported authenticated production per-window observer/transport or transparent UI-state observer is shipped or verified.
inferred_feasibility.native_state_needed: A supported window-scoped observation of actual UI handlers/active editing button, IME runtime, dispatch receiver and busy/load state, with native-window association and effective context keymap resolution. Existing internal C++ source owns relevant state; public Python timer/draw sampling does not expose it completely.
inferred_feasibility.source_boundary: Internal C++ existence does not establish a supported binary ABI/Python API or deployable observer. No pointer offsets, modal listener, guessed false values or thresholds are proposed.

missing_guard_facts.reason: Cursor hit or a selected area does not identify actual keyboard/event receiving editor.
Hovered property is distinct from active edit button identity and ownership.
Timer context null and operator-only collection do not enumerate all active UI/menu handlers or establish absence.
XIM registration/input method presence and IME support flags do not establish target-window composition state.
Specified job and load lifecycle evidence is partial; no complete busy/event-quiescence observer established.
OS facts and RNA window/region data are separately available, but authenticated OS-to-RNA mapping including multi-window/scale/namespaces is not established.
Effective dispatch includes context/modal routing, disabled/conflicting entries and event matching; first matching RNA binding is insufficient.

accessibility.observed_local_scope: Source enums/router labels and macOS permission check exist; no actual AT-SPI/UIA/AX active-widget collector or verified Blender accessibility tree is present in this repository/evidence.
accessibility.limit: No claim that Blender accessibility is universally impossible or unavailable on every platform.

conclusion: Partial trusted scene/window evidence is feasible. The named missing UI authorization facts prevent claiming a complete production provider or six-operation support; they do not block unrelated reachable tasks.
authority_limits: No guard/threshold change, fixture invariant substitution, data lock, quality PASS or adoption decision.
